notes:
Clearer pedal markings, and every tool now keeps its own colour.

**Pedal markings are drawn with thicker lines.** They were hard to pick out against staff lines, particularly when written over them. Only the line weight has changed — the marks are exactly the same size as before, and markings you have already placed become clearer too, without you having to touch them.

**Every tool now remembers the colour you last used with it.** Pen and highlighter already worked this way; now pistons, pedal markings, links, bowings, note stamps and IPA symbols do as well. Choosing red for pedal markings no longer changes the colour your pen writes in, and switching back to a tool brings back the colour you were using with it.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
